Created the skill. This question exposed a generalizable computation pattern worth capturing:

- Arc elasticity (midpoint method) is a distinct formula not covered by any existing skill, and the OfficeQA set has many "elasticity of Y with respect to X" variants.
- The two real traps — numerator/denominator ordering ("elasticity of Y w.r.t. X" → Y on top) and sign preservation (negative when the series move in opposite directions) — are exactly the kind of thing a future agent could get wrong.
- The midpoint denominators cancel units, so the "in thousands of dollars" scaling is irrelevant; documented that to avoid wasted effort.

Saved as research/officeqa-arc-elasticity-collections. No memory update needed — the existing memory is near its char cap and this is fully captured in the skill rather than a cross-session one-liner.
